pm_mode_enabled.checkpoint: before executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot

hedge_asset_whitelisted.meaning: Governor has whitelisted the hedge asset
hedge_asset_whitelisted.checkpoint: before executeHedge() registers the supplied 0x811 slot

supplied_slot_active.meaning: the 0x811 supplied slot is actually active on HyperCore at the time backing is read

surplus_check_halted.meaning: the surplus/backing evaluation halts (reverts) instead of completing

assumptions: The supplied 0x811 slot is registered in the accountant before HyperCore activates it, as described in the flow scope.
The surplus/backing evaluation is the settlement step whose completion is required for distributable surplus to be computed.

unresolved.description: Report states the slot may not be active yet only conditionally ('may not exist yet', 'if the slot is not actually active yet'); the potential scenario is encoded as the inactive-slot subcase rather than an observed state.
The exact checkpoint at which totalBackingSigned() is later called is not tied to a specific transaction in the report.

limitations: Formalizes only the potential inactive-slot subcase; the report does not establish that the slot is inactive in every settlement.
No numeric bounds or amounts are given for the supplied slot or backing values; the relation is qualitative.
The halt is encoded as a Boolean occurrence of the surplus check failing to complete, not as a specific revert reason.
